name: YTKACE
subtitle: Open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader
description: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS with SponsorBlock, background playback, player controls, and interface customization including liquid glass.

apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: Open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader
apps.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS with SponsorBlock, background playback, player controls, and interface customization including liquid glass.

versions.localizedDescription:
YTKACE 1.1.3

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.41.5
• Added Hide AI Channels, which hides videos from channels on the AiSList blocklist in your feed and search, with an option for the warnlist too
• Swipe the SponsorBlock popup away to dismiss it

Fixed:
• Shorts download button sometimes missing on the new Shorts UI
• Auto-Skip and Play Shorts Once not working on the new Shorts UI
• Pinch to fullscreen in Shorts freezing or starting the next Short
• Loop button not looping when Local Queue is on
• SponsorBlock popup not fading in
• Chapter pill in the player sometimes not getting Liquid Glass

YouTube 21.41.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.3_YouTube_21.41.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.3_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 1.1.2

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.40.5
• Redesigned the download tab to look more like YouTube, with an All tab and your active downloads shown at the top
• Smaller download popup that you can swipe away, and failed downloads stay so you can retry them
• Playlist downloads now get the whole playlist, including private playlists and Liked videos
• Liquid Glass tab bar is see-through while scrolling Shorts
• Added Frosted Tab Bar option (Default, On, Off)
• Added Normal Home Layout for the Home redesign some accounts get
• Added Remove Horizontal Shelves
• Added Hold to Copy Text for community posts and comments
• Added Play Shorts Once
• Added Two-Finger Tap to Pause
• Added Extra Dim
• Added Share at Current Time
• Added Lock Screen Skip
• Added Remove Suggestion Pill for Shorts
• SponsorBlock skip popup now fades in and out

Fixed:
• Shorts download button, Fullscreen and pinch to fullscreen on the new Shorts UI
• Captions On picking the wrong language
• App opening in Shorts when a different start tab is set
• White or black bar behind the Liquid Glass tab bar
• Share sheet position on iPad

YouTube 21.40.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_21.40.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 1.1.1

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.39.4
• Liquid Glass on iOS 26 for the tab bar, top bar buttons, menus, sheets, player buttons and YTKACE popups
• Liquid Glass settings page with a toggle for each part
• Selected Tab Color for the tab text or the text and icon
• Added HLS mode in Playback Fix
• Added 5x speed in the speed menu
• Improved native share sheet

Fixed:
• Multiple scrubber dots on feed videos with a custom scrubber
• Direct downloads using an outdated client

YouTube 21.39.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_21.39.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 1.1.0

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.38.3
• Redesigned the YTKACE library player with a floating mini player, PiP and YouTube style controls
• SponsorBlock now skips segments in downloaded videos
• New Download Method option with Direct downloads
• Modify YouTube's video zoom
• Keep Shorts in Subscriptions
• Option to disable PiP for Shorts
• Speed menu button
• Options to disable HDR, remove 1080p Premium and set a separate Shorts speed
• Layout mode option
• Choose the subtitle language for downloads

Fixed:
• PiP not working for music videos
• Gap left by hidden comment guidelines, topic chips and community posts
• Download and queue buttons on older YouTube versions
• Autoplay in queues
• Improved Playback Fix and download retrying

Thanks to @Ganeron11 and @kes158 for contributions

YouTube 21.38.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_21.38.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 1.0.1

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.38.2
• Download subtitles with your videos
• Transcript button to copy or share a video's captions
• Added toggle to Open videos paused instead of playing right away
• Search bar in YTKACE settings

Fixed:
• Crash on iOS 15
• Prevent Open in Shorts doing nothing
• Stop Autoplay doing nothing
• Queue not appearing until the video was reopened
• Captions turning off after Playback Fix recovers a video

YouTube 21.38.2 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_21.38.2.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 1.0.0

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.37.5
• Queue videos without Premium — play next, play last, reorder, shuffle, loop and clear
• Playlist downloads — grab every video or pick the ones you want
• YouTube's Download button can now open the YTKACE menu
• Choose where the download button lives: player overlay, YouTube's button, or both
• Save downloads to the share sheet, with separate video and audio destinations
• Hide the products shelf
• iOS 15 support for the tweak packages

Fixed:
• 2K and 4K missing from the download quality list
• Shorts Save button not removed unless YouTube was in English
• Community posts breaking with Block Premium Prompts on
• Action bar disappearing while scrolling the feed
• Settings unreachable if both the YTKACE and Library tabs were removed
• YTKACE settings opening another tweak's settings when both were installed

YouTube 21.37.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_21.37.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 0.9.3

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated for YouTube 21.36.6
• Added a toggle to remove the Save button from Shorts

Fixed:
• Fixed the feed lagging while scrolling with Remove Shorts, Products, Mixes or Community Posts on
• Fixed the You tab moving to the end of the tab bar after changing other tabs
• Fixed hold to speed staying stuck at the held speed after letting go
• Fixed the Save button in Shorts overlapping the other buttons
• Fixed Block Premium Prompts stopping community post images from opening
• Fixed Clear Cache saying there was nothing to clear while YouTube's video cache kept growing

YouTube 21.36.6 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_0.9.3_YouTube_21.36.6.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_0.9.3_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 0.9.2

by @itzzace0

What’s new:
• Updated for YouTube 21.35.3
• Added a save button to community post images, saved at full resolution
• Added Posts to the tab bar, so it can be shown as a tab or set as the startup tab
• Added a choice of where downloads are saved, between the YTKACE library, Photos, or asking each time
• Added a custom hold speed with a slider from 0.25x to 5x, and the speed pill now shows the speed you set
• Added a toggle to remove the ⋯ button from the action bar
• Added a toggle to remove the row of buttons under the progress bar in fullscreen
• Added a toggle to limit gestures to landscape only

Fixed:
• Fixed the app freezing while saving large videos to Photos
• Fixed tapping an image in the comments opening the share sheet
• Fixed a crash when rotating the player
• Fixed a crash when leaving the app while a message was on screen

YouTube 21.35.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_21.35.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 0.9.1

by @itzzace0

What’s new:
• Updated for YouTube 21.34.3
• Added a default startup tab option, so YouTube can open on any tab you choose
• Added a Shorts session limit that stops endless scrolling after a set number

Fixed:
• Fixed Save to Photos silently doing nothing, and it now confirms when a video is saved
• Fixed Save to Photos on large videos, and it now explains when Photos cannot store the format
• Fixed backing up settings producing an empty file with nothing in it
• Reduced feed scrolling lag from Remove Products, Shorts, Mixes and Community Posts

YouTube 21.34.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_0.9.1_YouTube_21.34.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_0.9.1_YouTube_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
